lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i asked, and i ordered a real main. straight off the mains list, no sides, no asking the waiter twice. i might cry a little :)

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: a loud table, a light plate and mina ordering first. best way to say goodbye to summer

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: no yogurt, no cheese, calm stomach. that water taxi ride home is going to be smooth sailing!!

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: every main here comes off the grill with meat on it. the only things without meat are the sides... and i said a real main this time

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: nope. we are not doing the plate of fries all over again. everybody up

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: mina finally asked out loud and we walked her straight into sides. we're moving, and she's choosing the next door

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: the waiter keeps pointing me to the meat-free mains... and every one of them is fish or seafood

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i'm the one who ASKED about fish!! and she said no!! we're out

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: nothing with a face. she said it once and that should've been enough. let's go

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: so good, but every plate came with a yogurt dip or cheese crumbled on top. this water taxi ride is going to feel very long

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll ride back with you and point you at the horizon. sailors swear by it

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: love the buzz in here, but my plate is swimming in oil. i asked for a light plate and got the night-market fryers all over again

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: long walk down the boardwalk after? we'll shake it off together

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: the food was lovely. but it was so quiet i could hear my own fork. summer ended early after all

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i whispered 'pass the bread' and three tables looked at me. next time, the loud place

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: pasta?? i won that race fair and square and i said GREEK

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'm not complaining, i'd eat anything right now. but roxy earned her greek. rematch next weekend?
